camera: Standing eye height on the public-side pavement beside the bus stop, several paces back from the hatch and slightly toward the cab end; nearly side-on wide shot, 28mm lens feel.
background: The maroon cab occupies frame left, with the dark serving compartment behind Kasun at centre. Beyond the vehicle at frame right are the road, low shopfronts and the same bus-stop pole and broad dark-green tree seen in the following counter panel.
picture: The maroon three-wheeler stands side-on along the curb, cab at frame left and raised serving hatch across the centre. Behind the ledge, the red mannequin stands with its chest angled screen right toward the work surface and its head tipped down toward a pastry tray, both hands supporting the tray just above its place on the ledge. The silver flask stands upright within reach beside the tray space, while the other pastry trays, kettle and pale cloth occupy the remaining counter.
